items:
Top Reasons to Book The Gathering Place:

* Public Beach Access Approx. 0.4 Miles Away
* Private Pool/Spa With Heating Options (Fee Applies)
* Golf Cart (6-Seater LSV) Included At The Home
* EV Charging Station (Level 2 – J1772)
* Rooftop Terrace + Firepit
* Lounge Area With Game Room + Kitchenette
* Summer Kitchen
* Propane/Gas Grill
* Professionally Managed

The Gathering Place is a stunning 8-bedroom, 9-bathroom luxury retreat located in the heart of Seagrove Beach along Scenic 30A. Accommodating up to 28 guests, this spacious coastal home blends refined design with warm, inviting interiors. With public beach access just a nine-minute walk away, it offers an exceptional setting for families and groups seeking an elevated escape along the Emerald Coast.

Inside, the open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas bring together a bright and beautifully composed setting for gathering, highlighted by natural light and elegant finishes. Each bedroom includes a private bathroom, creating a seamless blend of comfort and privacy throughout the home. The third-floor lounge provides an inviting spot to unwind, featuring comfortable seating, a spacious kitchenette, and a custom glass ping-pong table that adds a sophisticated touch to casual entertainment.

Outdoors, guests can enjoy a private resort-style pool and spa surrounded by ample seating, along with a covered summer kitchen and conversational space that creates an effortless place to gather throughout the day. A beautifully designed rooftop terrace complete with a modern firepit offers another refined setting ideal for sunset views and evening conversation. With a complimentary 6-passenger golf cart (LSV) included and close access to Seagrove’s dining, shopping, parks, and scenic paths, The Gathering Place sets the stage for a graceful and comfortable retreat along 30A.

*For added security, this home is equipped with a Ring Doorbell camera at the front door.

Home Layout and Bedroom Details:

1st Floor:

Kitchen: This chef’s kitchen is fully stocked for preparing meals with family and friends. It features sleek white cabinetry, polished quartz countertops, and a professional-grade gas range, complemented by high-end stainless steel appliances. Amenities include a built-in ice maker, wine fridge, microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator, toaster, Keurig, coffeepot, crockpot, griddle, and blender, along with all standard utensils and cookware. A spacious island with seating for 4 provides additional dining space, making it easy for everyone to gather and enjoy meals.

Dining Room: The dining room includes a large table with seating for up to 10, framed by a custom built-in corner bench that adds both comfort and character to the space.

Living Room: The living room offers 2 leather sectionals, accent chairs, and well-composed décor that sets a comfortable tone for gathering. The space opens out to the back patio and pool, creating a seamless indoor–outdoor experience. A wall-mounted TV completes the room, making it ideal for movie nights or relaxed evenings together.

Bedroom + Bathroom #1: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, accent chair, private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. There is a private bathroom with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom + Bathroom #2: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. There is a private bathroom with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Laundry: The laundry room is directly on the right when you enter the home. There is a full-sized washer and dryer, you will find all of the bath linens here.

Backyard: The backyard showcases a private resort-style pool and spa framed by comfortable loungers for relaxing throughout the day. Hammocks stretch along the fence line, adding to the tranquil feel of the space. A convenient outdoor shower sits nearby for rinsing off after a swim, and a covered summer kitchen with a lounge area provides a comfortable place to gather, grill, or unwind between dips in the pool.

2nd Floor:

Bedroom + Bathroom #3: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. Guests have direct access to the front balcony. There is a private bathroom with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom + Bathroom #4: This bedroom includes 2 custom-built queen/queen bunks, 2 beanbag chairs, a private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. Guests have direct access to the front balcony. There is a private bathroom with a Jack-and-Jill vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom + Bathroom #5: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. Guests have direct access to the back balcony. There is a private bathroom with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom + Bathroom #6: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. Guests have direct access to the back balcony. There is a private bathroom with a single vanity and bathtub/shower combination.

3rd Floor:

Lounge Area (Game Room + Kitchenette): The 3rd floor lounge offers a comfortable seating area with a Smart TV, creating a relaxed setting for quiet downtime. A well-equipped kitchenette sits nearby, complete with a refrigerator, built-in ice maker, microwave, bar seating, and a dedicated coffee station. The space also features a custom all-glass ping-pong table, adding a distinctive and enjoyable element to this area.

Bedroom + Bathroom #7: This bedroom includes 2 custom-built queen/queen bunks, 2 beanbag chairs, a private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. There is a private bathroom with a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bedroom + Bathroom #8: This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, private closet, and a mounted flat-screen TV. There is a private bathroom with a Jack-and-Jill vanity and large walk-in shower.

Bathroom #9: This full bathroom sits just off the game room in the lounge area. It includes a single vanity and large walk-in shower.

Rooftop Terrace: The rooftop terrace features a spacious setting with lounge chairs and Adirondack seating arranged around a modern firepit. A built-in counter with a sink provides space for serving drinks or simple refreshments, while the small tower room offers convenient access to the terrace. The area is designed for relaxed gatherings and sunset views, creating a peaceful place to unwind above the treetops.

House Rules:
-This is a NON-smoking property.
-Pets are NOT permitted in this home.

Student Booking Policies:
-College student groups must all inquire and get approval before booking. Rates for student groups are subject to change; the price will be determined upon inquiry.
-If a college student group is accepted, they will be subject to a $100.00 fully refundable damage deposit per person.
-Golf carts are not included for groups under the age of 25 or college student groups.

Parking:
-All cars must be in the driveway. 6 cars maximum. No Trailers, RVs, Scooters, Boats, or Motorcycles are permitted without approval.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
